9.     ORDINANCE —2”’ READING Creating Section 10.24.200, Vehicle Mufflers, Excessive
                                      —



       Smoke and Unreasonable Noise, and repealing Section 8.56.050, Motor Vehicle Mufflers,
       of the Municipal Code of the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, to revise and enhance
       provisions governing vehicle mufflers and noise, to establish a graduated penalty structure
       for recurring offenses, and to make conforming amendments as specified. (POSTPONED
       FROM AUGUST 25, 2025)

Dr. Aldrich moved to approve on 2 reading, seconded by Dr. Rinne. Dr. Aldrich moved to amend
section 10.24.200(DX5) to read “The operation of a vehicle with equipment improperly installed
or removed so as to produce unreasonable noise. This includes, but is not limited to unlawful,
defective or modified exhaust systems, vehicles lacking a functioning muffler or exhaust system.”
Seconded by Dr. Rinne. Motion to amend failed with Dr. Emmons and Dr. Rinne voting “NO”
and Dr. Aldrich voting “YES.” The main motion was approved by unanimous voice vote.

John Brodie, City Attorney, provided a staff report and Captain David Janes, Police Department,
provided additional information related to the enforcement of the current versus the proposed
ordinance. All committee members commented on the item, as did Ward I Councilman Pete
Labyourn.

There being no further items for the agenda to come before the Public Services Committee, the
meeting was adjourned at 12:40 p.m.
